integrity: Exact secant reduction and angular comparison constitute the proof; the standalone Python checker tests independently computed finite instances and does not certify infinitely many trajectories. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement bounds coincidences between first coordinates of two distinct classical solutions, not noisy output observability, reconstruction algorithms, delayed systems, or arbitrary fixed sigmoids. Strict decreasing inhibition is required. General historical disconjugacy theory may contain broader related results.
title: Sharp coordinate-crossing dichotomy for unequal-decay negative-feedback planar flows
